audit_items.proof_trace: `split_ctoken(amount)` atomically reduces the actual Balance<CToken> by exactly `amount` via `in_bag_balance.split(amount)` and synchronously updates `ctoken_values` to match the new balance in both the full-withdrawal (remove) and partial-withdrawal (borrow_mut + assign) cases. The only public-package paths to mutate `ctokens` on an obligation are `deposit_ctoken` (join) and `withdraw_ctokens` (split), both of which keep the two data structures in lockstep; no divergence path exists.
